layout.lede: Most small businesses can’t afford to hire for IT and marketing. We do both for you.

doors.title: Keep your tech working for you
doors.body: We help you choose the right software and manage it with cost savings in mind, so your business runs smoothly as it grows.

doors.title: Get found by more customers
doors.body: We manage your website, Google listing, ads and social media to bring in more leads.

layout.heading: You didn’t start a business to manage software or post on Instagram.
layout.sub: But someone has to do it. Most owners end up with one of these options.

cards.title: Hire someone
cards.body: A full-time IT or marketing person is expensive. A small team often doesn’t have enough work to keep them busy.

cards.title: Do it yourself
cards.body: Every hour you spend on admin is an hour you’re not spending on customers.

cards.title: Put it off
cards.body: Security gaps grow, you pay for software you don’t use, and competitors show up ahead of you in search.

items.text: Owners spend about 11 hours a week on admin. That’s almost twice the time they spend on sales and growth.
of owners who hand off work grew their revenue in two years. Only 66% of owners who don’t hand off work did.

layout.heading: Or you can hand it to us, for a fixed monthly cost that scales as your team grows.

items.title: The right software, set up and managed
items.body: We help you choose the right software, set it up, and manage it with cost savings in mind. Your team works more efficiently, and your systems keep up as you grow.
items.points:
Choose and set up software, including accounting, payroll and HR
Set up and remove accounts when staff join or leave
Track licences so you only pay for what you use
Back up your data and keep your accounts secure

items.title: More people find you and get in touch
items.body: We help customers find your business online and make it easy for them to contact you.
items.points:
Build and manage your website
Help you show up on Google and in AI tools like ChatGPT
Run ads that bring in leads
Keep your social media and business listings up to date

layout.heading: When one team does both, you see the full picture.
layout.sub: Marketing brings in new customers. IT helps your business run well as it grows. When two different companies handle these, nobody sees the full picture. When we handle both, you do.

layout.caption: We connect your marketing to the tools your team uses to quote and bill. So you can see how much your marketing really brings in.

layout.heading: See your whole business in one place
layout.sub: Because we manage both, we can show your marketing and IT numbers together. You’ll find them in one dashboard in your client portal, and it updates on its own.

layout.caption: Sample data shown. Included when your monthly plan totals over $400.

layout.heading: Other reasons to use one team

cards.title: One team
cards.body: You only have to explain your business once.

cards.title: One number to call
cards.body: The same people help with your website and your software.

cards.title: One bill
cards.body: One monthly price instead of paying several companies.

layout.heading: You may qualify for funding.
layout.body: Ontario businesses can get up to $15,000 through DMAP to plan their technology. We’ll tell you if you’re likely to qualify before you apply.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.body: Tell us how things work today and what you’d like help with. It’s free and there’s no commitment.

steps.title: We review your setup
steps.body: We look at your software, website and marketing to find where you’re losing time or money.

steps.title: You get a plan
steps.body: We give you a simple plan and a fixed monthly price. You decide what to go ahead with.

layout.heading: Tell us what you’d like help with.
layout.sub: Send us a short note. A partner will reply and let you know if we’re a good fit.
